title: GMAT Focus Data Insights Practice Test 16
instructions: Original exam-style practice test with answers and explanations.

questions.prompt: A graph showing student assessment pass rates in the education sector presents the following data: Mathematics: 73%, Science: 68%, English: 81%, History: 77%, Languages: 62%. According to the graph, which segment/period shows the highest value?
options: D. The value closest to the overall average
E. Cannot be determined from the data
questions.explanation: This graphics_interpretation question tests ability to interpret education data on student assessment pass rates.

questions.prompt: Based on the chart of claims processing times data (Auto: 8.2 days, Home: 14.5 days, Health: 6.1 days, Life: 21.3 days), which TWO values would combine to equal approximately the average?
questions.explanation: This graphics_interpretation question tests ability to interpret insurance data on claims processing times.

dataContext.data: Auto: 8.2 days, Home: 14.5 days, Health: 6.1 days, Life: 21.3 days

questions.prompt: A scatter plot comparing project completion on schedule across construction categories shows: Residential: 58%, Commercial: 44%, Infrastructure: 37%, Industrial: 51%. If the trend continued, which projection is most consistent?
options: A. The value closest to the overall average
B. Cannot be determined from the data
questions.explanation: This graphics_interpretation question tests ability to interpret construction data on project completion on schedule.

questions.prompt: A graph showing crop yield indices in the agriculture sector presents the following data: Wheat: 108, Corn: 95, Rice: 112, Soybeans: 103, Cotton: 89. According to the graph, which segment/period shows the highest value?
questions.explanation: This graphics_interpretation question tests ability to interpret agriculture data on crop yield indices.

questions.prompt: Analysis of return rates by product category in e-commerce: Electronics: 12%, Clothing: 28%, Home goods: 8%, Books: 3%, Sports: 15%. Select the value closest to the median AND the value that represents the greatest deviation from the mean.

questions.prompt: A tourism manager reviews visitor spending by activity: Accommodation: 38%, Food: 24%, Transport: 18%, Entertainment: 12%, Shopping: 8%. Select: (1) the category requiring immediate attention and (2) the category that exceeds the target of the average by the greatest margin.
questions.explanation: This two_part_analysis question tests ability to interpret tourism data on visitor spending by activity.

questions.prompt: Three data sources on environmental emissions reduction by sector are provided: (Memo) Overall performance improved this quarter. (Table) Energy: -14%, Transport: -8%, Industry: -6%, Agriculture: -3%, Buildings: -11%. (Email) Stakeholders express concern about outliers. Which source most directly supports the memo's claim?
options: C. All three sources are equally relevant
questions.explanation: This multi_source_reasoning question tests ability to interpret environmental data on emissions reduction by sector.

questions.prompt: Reviewing streaming media records: Source A shows content viewing patterns: Drama: 35%, Comedy: 22%, Documentary: 18%, Action: 15%, Other: 10%. Source B notes the average. Source C flags values more than 25% above or below average. Which values would Source C flag?
options: E. All three sources are equally relevant

questions.prompt: Three data sources on supply chain supplier performance scores are provided: (Memo) Overall performance improved this quarter. (Table) Quality: 87/100, Delivery: 79/100, Price: 83/100, Responsiveness: 91/100, Sustainability: 74/100. (Email) Stakeholders express concern about outliers. Which source most directly supports the memo's claim?
options: A. All three sources are equally relevant
questions.explanation: This multi_source_reasoning question tests ability to interpret supply chain data on supplier performance scores.

questions.prompt: What is the relative ranking of categories in fitness gym membership usage? (1) Peak hours 6-8am: 42%. (2) The remaining values follow a consistent trend.
options: A. Each statement alone is sufficient
B. Neither statement alone nor together is sufficient
C. Statement (1) alone is sufficient, but statement (2) alone is not sufficient
D. Statement (2) alone is sufficient, but statement (1) alone is not sufficient
E. Both statements together are sufficient, but neither alone is sufficient
questions.explanation: This data_sufficiency question tests ability to interpret fitness data on gym membership usage.

questions.prompt: Is the cybersecurity incident response times above the industry benchmark of the median? (1) Detection: 4.2h. (2) The range of all values is 3.9h.
